pluginMetaData.name: Web Support (with Message Flow)
pluginMetaData.author: Chris Gibson
pluginMetaData.description: Installs the embedded OIE web administrator and its supporting REST endpoints (byte-exact message serialization, server-side JavaScript validation, installed extensions' web UIs) -- the original Web Support plugin, unmodified -- plus Message Flow: a nav tab visualizing how channels route to one another (Channel Writer destinations and router.routeMessage()/routeMessageByChannelId() script calls), a "View in Message Flow" channel action, and the read-only /api/extensions/messageFlow/topology REST endpoint backing both. This combined package exists so Message Flow runs inside the already-authenticated Web Support shell instead of as its own separately-deployed page.
